$comment: Debug-server methods that deliberately have no typed tool in mcp/src/tools/.
Every one is still callable: `node mcp/ge.mjs raw <method> '{...}'`.
Tests/Mcp/ipc-method-drift.mjs fails if a handler is neither covered by a tool
nor listed here, so adding a RegisterHandler forces a tool-or-raw-only choice.
Promoting one to a tool means adding it under mcp/src/tools/ and deleting its
entry here — the check fails on a redundant entry, so this list cannot rot.

rawOnly.tileset_author_terrain: Fills in a tile set's terrain set and per-tile peering bits and saves through the panel — the terrain-canvas authoring gesture without a viewport; raw-driven beside tilemap_paint_cells.
rawOnly.tilemap_paint_intgrid: Paints semantic IntGrid values through the Scene View paint tool as one undo-boundary stroke, so live rule re-dressing is exercised; raw-driven beside tilemap_paint_cells.
rawOnly.tilemap_author_rules: Defines an IntGrid layer's value table and a Tiles layer's auto-tiling rule set (explicit spec or terrain wizard) and re-dresses it; the rules-panel authoring gesture without a viewport.
rawOnly.tilemap_rules_state: Reports each layer's IntGrid values, rule-set shape and optionally a window of cells with their provenance — the first check when a dressed layer looks wrong.
rawOnly.tilemap_import: Runs the same source importer as the Assets context action; the raw import harness checks written map and tileset paths and warnings.
rawOnly.tilemap_paint_cells: Drives the Scene View tilemap paint tool as one undo-boundary stroke; the authoring harness calls it over raw alongside select_entity and undo.
rawOnly.tilemap_save: Writes the resident tilemap back to its .tilemap asset; paired with tilemap_paint_cells in the same raw flow, so promote the pair together.
rawOnly.tileset_create_from_texture: Runs the Tile Set Editor panel's new-tileset action, writing the .tileset before it returns; part of the raw tilemap authoring flow, promote the set together.
rawOnly.tilemap_select: Sets/clears the paint tool's marquee selection; the bounded fill and copy/move flows are driven over raw alongside tilemap_paint_cells.
rawOnly.tilemap_clipboard: Copy/paste of a selected cell region, one undo entry per paste; part of the same raw tilemap authoring flow, promote the set together.
rawOnly.tilemap_move_selection: Moves the selected cell region by a delta as one undo entry — the marquee drag without a viewport.
rawOnly.tilemap_replace_tile: Rewrites every cell holding one tile id on the target layer or the map as one undo entry; raw-driven beside tilemap_paint_cells.
rawOnly.tilemap_fill_rect: Rect-tool fill over a cell rectangle with the tiled/scattered stamp; raw-driven beside tilemap_select.
rawOnly.tilemap_tool_state: Reports whether the Scene View has the tilemap paint tool armed, plus the live selection/stamp — the first check when a tilemap gesture appears inert.
rawOnly.debug_crash: Deliberate crash injection for testing the crash handler; must stay awkward to reach.
rawOnly.assistant_bind: The AI Assistant's MCP server binding its connection to a conversation; the server sends it itself on every connection.
rawOnly.assistant_authorize: The AI Assistant's MCP server asking the editor before a tool that writes files or starts processes; the server sends it itself.
rawOnly.respond_modal: Modal-dialog plumbing for scripted scene flows; driven over raw by the integration harness.
rawOnly.open_context_menu: Context-menu capture; the raw JSON round-trip is what the UI test flows already drive.
rawOnly.get_context_menu: Reads back the last open_context_menu capture — meaningless without that raw call before it.
rawOnly.invoke_menu_item: Third step of the context-menu sequence; promote the trio together, not one at a time.
rawOnly.set_text_field: Direct field write that skips per-keystroke callbacks; input_text is the usual path.
rawOnly.send_text: Lower-level text injection; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.get_sky_settings: Diagnostic readback of the sky's per-frame SkySettings for comparing two runs or builds input by input; raw-only until a sky tool group exists.
rawOnly.show_universal_search: Opens the universal search overlay; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.simulate_mouse_drag: Press-move-release drag for UI flows; no typed tool yet. Its dragDropSession field says whether the gesture started a drag-and-drop session; perform_drop makes a drop without one.
rawOnly.simulate_double_click_drag: Double-click-then-drag variant; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.set_scroll: Sets a ScrollView offset; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.undock_panel: Floats a docked panel; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.open_scene: Scene loading with dirty-prompt and crash-recovery policy; the parameter contract deserves a schema before promotion.
rawOnly.spawn_model: Spawns a model asset; spawn_skinned_model covers the skinned case that had a workflow behind it.
rawOnly.export_model_materials: One-off model material export; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.enumerate_provenance: Asset provenance dump; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.set_entity_enabled: Toggles entity enablement; set_component reaches the same state today.
rawOnly.select_smart_folder: Assets-panel smart folder selection; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.get_asset_sources: Lists mounted asset roots; get_build_settings answers the usual mount question.
rawOnly.get_asset_list: Registered-asset listing; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.import_proflares: One-off ProFlares importer; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.set_scene_view_mode: Scene-view display mode; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.set_scene_tool: Sets the active gizmo tool; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.get_scene_tool: Reads the active gizmo tool; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.capture_shadow_diagnostics: Deferred shadow/draw-stream stability hashes; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.get_mesh_registry: MeshGPURegistry dump; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.get_ui_clip_stats: UI clip-rect statistics; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.movie_record: Movie recording start/stop; the editor's own recorder UI owns this workflow.
rawOnly.spawn_bench_scene: Benchmark scene spawner used by perf runs, which drive it over raw.
rawOnly.physics_raycast: Single-shot physics raycast; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.get_terrain_debug: Per-entity terrain dump: component, splat/heightfield stats, authored grass parameters, and the per-view grassPlacement rows — placed-blade counts, each row's liveness (isCurrent/framesSinceDeclared: a view that stops being declared keeps serving its last count, so read those first), and the always-on grass dropout tallies (zeroGrassFrames/staleArgFrames/lastDropoutFrameIndex, dated against the top-level grassFrameIndex). Raw-only because it is a diagnostic wall of numbers rather than a question. NOT covered by get_terrain_stats, which answers CBT tessellation health and carries no grass data at all.
rawOnly.cbt_force_vertex_eval: Forces a CBT vertex evaluation pass; a terrain-debugging primitive, not a workflow.
rawOnly.get_cbt_tree_audit: CBT watertightness audit of the live tree (a ~160 MiB one-shot readback: CPU edge multiset over the decoded HeapIDs plus link, occupancy, corner-cache and draw-stream checks); a terrain-debugging primitive, not a workflow.
rawOnly.terrain_sculpt_dab: Applies one terrain sculpt dab; no typed tool yet.
rawOnly.set_terrain_brush: Configures the terrain sculpt brush; pairs with terrain_sculpt_dab, promote together.
rawOnly.graph_set_viewport: Scripting/verification helper: sets the live node graph canvas's pan and zoom (each optional) and returns the values it applied, so a capture can frame a known region; too niche for a typed tool.
rawOnly.graph_spike_dummy_nodes: B1 spike: spawn pooled dummy GraphPortedNode slots. Measurement-only, not a user workflow.
rawOnly.graph_get_nodes: Scripting/verification helper: lists the active graph's node ids/types/positions; too niche for a typed tool.
rawOnly.graph_delete_node: Scripting/verification helper: deletes one node by id through the canvas's undo-scoped delete path; too niche for a typed tool.
